name: Chained Soldier
description: Destructive monsters from the Mato dimension threaten the earth, while women gifted with powers from Peaches try to stop them. But to save the world, Yuuki must be willing to become Chief Kyoka's servant both on the battlefield and at home.

videos.title: Birth, Yuuki, Awakening
videos.overview: Yuuki Wakura wanders through a gate to an alternate dimension. He meets the Demon Defense Force including Chief Kyouka Uzen, who will reward him for his servitude.

videos.title: Curiosity, Shushu, Undress
videos.overview: Yuuki is recruited to work as a caretaker at the 7th Squadron’s dorm in Mato. Shushu catches him unaware and turns him into her boy toy. Suddenly, a giant Shuuki attacks!

videos.title: Encounter, Kyouka,  Rampage
videos.overview: With dozens of Shuuki detected, and a score to settle, Yuuki and the Demon Defense Force Squadron take an interdimensional trip!

videos.title: Whirlwind, Himari, Roar
videos.overview: The Demon Defense Force decides to take measures against the humanoid Shuuki. Meanwhile, Himari can adopt someone else’s ability, which she does to turn Yuuki “loyal” to her.

videos.title: Sisters, Yachiho, Ridicule
videos.overview: Yuuki hits Yachiho with a “Brand Break,” so she rewinds to before the beginning of the match. Later, Himari appreciates Yuuki; it’s time for his reward to begin!

videos.title: Blitz, Sahara, Twinkle
videos.overview: Up next in Round 2: It's Shushu Suruga of the 7th Squadron versus Sahara Wakasa of the 6th Squadron! And after the match, Shushu has a surprise for Yuuki.

videos.title: United Front, Tenka, Soar
videos.overview: Tenka confronts Rairen, then uses her ability to manipulate space. Later, Yuuuki tidies up and gets a face full of more than dirty laundry!

videos.title: Promise, Nei, Remember
videos.overview: Tenka wants Yuuki as her new pet, but Kyouka declines her request. Nei explains her clairvoyant powers, the “promise.”

videos.title: Reunion, Coco, Lick
videos.overview: A demon who looks like Yuuki’s sister appears and abducts him! Then after the dust settles, an enemy licks Yuuki down for... medical reasons.

videos.title: War, Naon, Recite
videos.overview: Yuuki learns a less than peachy truth. Later, he receives a finger licking good reward.

videos.title: Death Match, Aoba, Excite
videos.overview: With Yuuki tied up and unable to fight, it’s up to the girls to harness the power of the peaches in a non-stop battle. Suddenly, those who control the demons appear...

videos.title: Homecoming, New, Resolve
videos.overview: Yuuki finds a new reason to fight: to return Aoba to her original human form.

videos.title: Commanders' Meeting
videos.overview: The 7th Squad may have settled into a new normal, but trouble soon follows when the commanders hold a meeting.

videos.title: Ren's Shadow
videos.overview: Ren grows increasingly interested in Yukki, especially once one of the Eight Thunder Gods appears in his room.

videos.title: A Storm Rolls In
videos.overview: Yakumo wants nothing more than a harem full of women. But when she sets her sights on Yuuki, she just might decide to add him, too.

videos.title: Rampage
videos.overview: When Ren orders Kyouka to lend her Yuuki, the Supreme Commander unlocks a form befitting her power. However, even her might isn't enough to deny Yuuki a reward.

videos.title: The Azuma Banquet
videos.overview: A contest will decide the next head of the Azuma Family.

videos.title: A New Azuma
videos.overview: Fubuki challenges Himari to a duel.

videos.title: Late Summer Slave
videos.overview: Kyouka notices how many women are growing closer to Yuuki.

videos.title: The Commander of the 2nd Squadron
videos.overview: When a Thunder God begins abducting women, the Demon Defense Force sends Mira and Kyouka to confront her.

videos.title: A Commander's Resolve
videos.overview: Mira is a formidable fighter, but her opponent is a Thunder God. If she wants to win, she'll have to pull out all the stops.

videos.title: Yokohama Showdown
videos.overview: Kuusetsu's new power makes her more dangerous than ever.

videos.title: Slave: Heaven
videos.overview: Yuuki and Kyouka have come a long way, and they've forged a bond strong enough to stand against a god. But even if they win this battle, the war is far from over.

videos.title: Gods Assemble
videos.overview: In the aftermath, both the Demon Defense Force and the Thunder Gods prepare for what comes next.
